messages:
claire: Heads up — AcmeHealth asked for a launch-ready console snapshot: per-tenant cost breakdown, trace hooks for latency hotspots, and an error analytics view that de-identifies PII. They want a Dedicated preview by end of Q2. Can we scope this?

aj: Sounds like three big asks. What's 'de-identifies PII' mean for error payloads? redaction or tokenization? @tess

tess: Redaction. CS prefers removing sensitive fields at ingest with a configurable allowlist. Also they want trace sampling to include caller info for SDK spans (not full stack frames initially).

mike: For tracing hooks: adding span tags + a sampling flag is low lift. Including stack frames is higher-cost — payload size and CPU. Need perf numbers.

nina: Cost breakdown ask: per-route, per-model, per-tenant lines. We already emit per-token cost but no route rollups; we can approximate per-route by mapping route -> model usage in the router.

claire: Proposed MVP scope cut: 1) Dashboard widgets: per-tenant cost + top-10 routes; 2) Tracing: span-level markers + per-customer sample flag (no stack frames); 3) Errors: ingest-time PII redaction + deterministic error grouping. Defer stack frames and per-model attribution to follow-up.

aj: Agree with MVP. Add launch gating: 2 weeks of stability on Dedicated, latency regression <5% on tail p95/p99, and privacy audit sign-off.

tess: Acceptance criteria (proposal):
```
- Dashboard: per-tenant cost chart (last 30d) + top-10 routes by cost
- Tracing: ability to attach `redwood.trace.service` tag; per-customer sample rate control
- Errors: configurable redaction rules + deterministic grouping by message+signature
- E2E tests: synthetic traffic to validate tail latency and cost rollups
```

mike: Implementation notes: add a pipeline transformer to remove PII fields (config-driven). Add a per-tenant feature flag for trace hooks. ETA: 3 sprints for infra + 1 sprint for QA and docs.

nina: CS wants a customer validation window with AcmeHealth next week. They need a staging link to try the dashboard and error UI.

claire: Next steps: eng to confirm sprint plan (mike, aj), CS to schedule validation (nina), PM (me) to draft scope doc and launch checklist. @mike can you confirm risk #1: latency impact from redaction? @aj confirm rollout gating?

mike: Risk: naive redaction adds ~2–5ms per event if implemented inline. Micro-batching reduces per-event cost; Rust transformer expected ~2ms. I'll spike perf and open a PR by Friday.

aj: Rollout gating: must include a fallback to disable redaction per-tenant and a traffic-sampling fallback. If perf impact >8ms we gate. Also need automated alerts for cost accounting mismatch >5%.

claire: I'll add those gating rules to the roadmap ticket and surface tradeoffs in the roadmap update. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: staging preview deployed for feature/scope-2534567890 — https://staging.redwood/preview/2534567890

claire: Thanks — I'll file the ticket and loop everyone on the kickoff doc.
